cards.name: Zhuang Fangyi
cards.text:
Manual: Friendly cards with Illusory may attack the enemy's back row cards opposite them until the end of this turn.
Protocol: Target a friendly card with a countdown and increase its countdown by 1.

cards.name: Perlica
cards.text:
Passive: Illusory.
Auto: If this card expires, deal 4 damage to your opponent.

cards.name: Ember
cards.text:
Passive: Taunt.
Protocol: If the operator opposite this card has equal or less DEF than this card, destroy it. If there is no operator opposite this card, deal 3 damage to your opponent.

cards.name: Wulfgard
cards.text:
Passive: Helidrop.
Protocol: Gain 2 DP, and this card gets +2 ATK until the end of the turn.

cards.name: Xaihi
cards.text:
Passive: Illusory. When this card is in your back row, friendly front-row operators have +1 ATK.
Manual: Obtain any summon from the extra deck.

cards.name: Electric Pylon
cards.text:
Passive: Illusory. This card is unaffected by all arts or operator card abilities.
Auto: At the start of your turn, draw 1 card.
Auto: If this card is destroyed by battle, deal 2 damage to the controller of the attacking card.

cards.name: Alesh
cards.text: Instant: Either Rescue an Endfield card or Summon an Endfield card in the extra deck. Then, if you control a card with Illusory, you may reduce its countdown by 1.

cards.name: Typhoeus
cards.text: Passive: Taunt. If Typhoeus loses a battle, roll a d6. If the result is a 4 or higher, Typhoeus retreats instead, and her DP cost reduces by 1 until she is played again.

cards.name: Mr Dolly
cards.text:
Passive: This card always has 0 ATK. Mr Dolly cards may only attack once all operators on your field which can attack have attacked.
Auto: When this card is destroyed, the opponent heals 2 HP.

cards.name: Mr Dolly
cards.text:
Passive: This card always has 0 ATK. Mr Dolly cards may only attack once all operators on your field which can attack have attacked.
Auto: When this card is destroyed, the opponent heals 2 HP.

cards.name: Mr Dolly
cards.text:
Passive: This card always has 0 ATK. Mr Dolly cards may only attack once all operators on your field which can attack have attacked.
Auto: When this card is destroyed, the opponent heals 2 HP.

cards.name: Gilberta
cards.text:
Passive: Hovering. Friendly Illusory cards have +1 DEF.
Manual: Either give a friendly operator Illusory, and move it to a friendly back row tile, or move a card with Illusory in the back row to an empty front-row tile.

cards.name: Tangtang
cards.text:
Instant: Destroy a friendly back-row card, then deal 2 damage to your opponent and refresh one manual or active ability of any card on the field.
(Location cards are not on the field)

cards.name: Arclight
cards.text:
Passive: Illusory.
Instant: Gain 2 DP if this card or the card before this is played in the back row.

cards.name: Ardelia
cards.text: Auto: At the end of each of your turns, Summon Mr Dolly from the extra deck onto your opponent's field if possible. (Maximum of 3 Mr Dolly cards to be present on the field.)

cards.name: Endministrator
cards.text:
Passive: Helidrop. Overwhelm.
Protocol: Target an enemy operator and destroy it. If there are no enemy operators that can be targeted, deal 3 damage to your opponent instead.

cards.name: Automated Industry Complex
cards.text:
Passive: Cards which can be played on the back row cost 1 less DP to deploy.
Active: 1 DP: Target a friendly card with a countdown. You may either reduce its countdown by 1 or increase its countdown by 1. If this is the first time this turn activating this ability, you may choose to activate this ability again immediately. (still need to pay costs)
